instruction: A clean studio fashion photograph with a medium close-up shot at eye-level. Against a solid beige studio background, the blonde woman in the green blazer (R1) sits on the left, leaning her head slightly toward her companion and looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression. Beside her on the right, the dark-haired woman in the white blazer (R2) sits close, looking off-camera to the left with a calm expression. Their shoulders and arms are pressed together in a close, leaning pose. The scene is illuminated by soft, even studio lighting with minimal shadows, highlighting the bright green, clean white, and neutral beige color palette.
